description: This file defines the PricingService interface, specifying methods for calculating product prices, formatted amount display, and retrieving string representations, used within the sales management application.

classes.name: PricingService
classes.description: Interface for product pricing services, including calculation of prices with various parameters and formatting monetary amounts for display.

methods.name: calculateProductPrice
methods.description: Calculates the final price of a product, optionally considering customer details and product attributes.

methods.name: getDisplayAmount
methods.description: Formats a BigDecimal amount into a display-friendly string according to store settings.

methods.name: getDisplayAmount
methods.description: Formats a BigDecimal amount into a display-friendly string using locale and currency information.

methods.name: getStringAmount
methods.description: Retrieves a string representation of the amount without currency symbols, formatted for the store.
